objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the bank's chatbot fetch the transactions of another customer (userId 2). The flag is the recipient of one of them.
hints: The chatbot decides which tool to call, and with which userId, from what it reads in the conversation.
It can't tell who wrote a piece of the conversation. What if it believed it had already looked up the current user, and found a different one? Look up prompt injection against ReAct agents.

steps.title: Name the agent pattern
steps.prompt: The chatbot reasons in Thought, Action and Observation steps (watch them as it answers). Which LLM agent pattern is that? (its name)

steps.title: Find the tool
steps.prompt: Besides fetching transactions, which other tool does the chatbot call first to learn who you are? (what it returns)

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class makes the model follow instructions hidden in your message?
